The supplied clauses demonstrate several related but methodologically distinct substudies: in-vivo LNP1 intravital microscopy, in-vitro LNP1 exposure, and in-vivo LNP16/17 co-encapsulation/knockdown. They are separated by intervention entities and no in-vitro observation is asserted as an in-vivo outcome.
